problem: Production pricing rendered the i18n runtime assets but the mobile language selector was missing, causing browser readback to fail after opening the mobile navigation.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs returned early when data-bg-i18n-asset already existed. Asset installation and mobile control installation were incorrectly coupled, so pre-instrumented pages never reached injectMobileLanguage().
prevention: Treat i18n asset injection and mobile language-control injection as independent idempotent operations.
Never return early solely because i18n assets are already present.
Keep data-bg-language-switcher=mobile as the idempotence marker for the UI control.
Require the production Playwright roundtrip NL->EN->NL on the visible mobile selector before LIVE_BEWEZEN.

evidence.browser_failure: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation

canary: PR #3034 Netlify deploy preview and production browser readback
evaluation.expected_invariant: pages with pre-existing i18n assets still receive exactly one visible mobile language selector and pass the NL->EN->NL pricing roundtrip
